question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Humility
solution:
The correct answer is: **Arrogance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Humility"** means a modest or low view of one's own importance; humbleness. (विनम्रता)

 
 
• **Example:** Her humility was evident as she always credited her team for the success.
 
 
 
• **"Arrogance"** refers to having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities. (घमंड)
 
 
• **Example:** His arrogance made it difficult for him to accept any form of criticism.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Humility'** is **'Arrogance'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shyness** (शर्मीला): The quality of being timid or reserved.

 
 
• **Example:** Her shyness often kept her from speaking up in meetings.
 
 
 
• **Timidity** (भीरुता): Lack of courage or confidence.
 
 
• **Example:** His timidity prevented him from trying new things.
 
 
 
• **Obedience** (आज्ञाकारिता): Compliance with an order, request, or law.
 
 
• **Example:** The dog's obedience made it easy to train.
